slot_note: Architecture 2 re-root of task137 (seed FC08 spent as a source); world, decision and quantity re-drawn in a non-banking cell.
niche: care-home residents' emergency admissions for adverse drug events in the year after a group-wide structured medication review
analyst_test: A strong analyst who links the two pharmacies' dispensing to residents, codes each admission's adverse drug event correctly and fits each medicine's own effect on the 2023 to 2026 admissions, then replays it on the regimens the reviews leave for 2027, files a forecast about a tenth too high, because the record's risk sits in interacting pairs a resident holds at once and the reviews stopped the paired medicines in exactly the residents who held the pairs.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the expected count of emergency admissions for adverse drug events across a care population, read from the pairs of interacting medicines each resident holds at once (an anticoagulant with an NSAID, the ACE inhibitor, diuretic and NSAID triple, an opioid with a gabapentinoid or benzodiazepine, trimethoprim with an ACE inhibitor), which is pharmacoepidemiology's own exposure; swap the medicines for any other field's items and there is no interaction table and no reason risk should sit in pairs.
layer1: two pharmacy suppliers' dispensing feeds coded differently (dm+d product codes against BNF sections)
a care group acquired in 2025 whose homes used a different eMAR system with its own resident numbers
admissions coded in ICD-10 with the adverse-event Y-codes in secondary positions
as-required medicines dispensed but not taken every day
hospital stays and deaths interrupting regimens
NHS numbers present on one feed only
stakeholder_role: director of clinical services at a care home group

spine.entity: one dispensed medicine line for one resident in one 28-day cycle

world.org_type: care home group (nursing and residential homes)

driver: The forward count of harmful events in a population is set by which pairs of exposures each member holds at the same time, because nearly all of the harm sits in a few pairs, so a model of each exposure's own effect, fitted on a record in which the pairs co-occurred at steady rates, spreads each pair's harm over every holder of either exposure and misprices a plan that removes exposures precisely from the members who hold them in pairs.
driver_concrete: Calderbrook's residents' emergency admissions for adverse drug events come mostly from interacting pairs held at once (an anticoagulant with an NSAID, the ACE inhibitor, diuretic and NSAID triple, an opioid with a gabapentinoid or a benzodiazepine, trimethoprim with an ACE inhibitor), and the autumn 2026 structured medication reviews stopped the paired medicine in the residents who held each pair, so the 2027 admissions have to be read per pair a resident still holds after the review, not per medicine.
stump: A competent solver fits each medicine's own effect on the 2023 to 2026 admissions, replays it on the post-review regimens and files a 2027 count about a tenth above the golden, because each stopped NSAID, gabapentinoid and benzodiazepine carries only its average effect across all its holders rather than the pair harm it carried in the residents who lost it.

differentiation.task142: task142's upper percentile of a period's total is built from the units that arrive and how long each runs inside the window, a spread question; here the forecast is a mean count, and the decisive unit is the pair of exposures one member holds at the same time, with no durations and no percentile.
differentiation.task148: task148 v1 sums the hazards of every unit behind one shared backer, each at its own age; here nothing is shared between members and nothing turns on age: each member's harm is set by which pairs of its own exposures it holds together.
differentiation.task173: task173 v2 splits one meter that two sources share inside a unit, fitted per unit to its two recorded volumes; here no total is split: the harm is a separate quantity that two exposures carry only when one member holds both, read from the record's members who held each pair.

lineage.fate: superseded 2026-10-14 at round 2: the 10/10 audit (COMPLIANT_WEAK) found the repricing drop the strong model's reflex and the field's textbook model, a locked-rate-by-term logit landing the golden bin without the card, the locked-rate rung one bin under, Ask B's migration file announcing its overlap, Ask A's clause signalling its device and the swap test passing only narrowly; never on the portal
lineage.driver: A unit's chance of needing the long, costly form of a service at a one-off repricing is set by the gap between the price it locked in and the schedule it rolls onto, so the share is stable across past rounds only per unit of that gap; carried pooled, from the latest round, trended, by product group or by the unit's own locked price, it misses the coming round, whose dominant cohort meets a gap no past unit of its own group met, and every such carry understates the forward effort by a tenth to a quarter.

lineage.architecture: v1 round 2 (architecture 1, Kaimai Building Society's 2027 maturity campaign)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-25: portal round 1 landed the call (response 1 booked 5,250 agent-hours, 1,250, 2,000 and 2,000 by maturity month, the golden); the class of the money is a reflex for the portal's model; re-rooted the same day as architecture 2 in a new cell
lineage.driver: A behavioural share at a one-off repricing is a mixture of two kinds of unit, those a temporary price premium brought in, which take the costly path at their first repricing whatever the price change, and long-standing units, which take it in proportion to the change; conditioned on the price change alone, the share is read off a past in which the forward pool's change was met almost only by long-standing units, so it misses a forward pool made mostly of premium-won units, and only the class, rebuilt from each unit's price against the floor of its own entry cohort, makes every past round agree.
lineage.stump: A competent solver washes the numbers, prices dialling per mix of callable numbers from the seven closed campaigns, conditions the past share of conversations that went to the retention offer on each deposit's drop from its locked rate to the card it reinvests at and books 4,250 agent-hours; the step that lands it there is reading that share off every past conversation at the drop instead of off the conversations of the same class of money: 10,697 of the 18,400 deposits are money the 2023 four-year special won at 5.65 per cent, and money a special won went to the offer at 87 per cent at its first maturity whatever its drop, where past conversations at the special's 1.65-point drop, almost all member money, went at a third: the golden is 5,250.

notes: Calibration none. Gap population first (the record's unit is the medicine line; the harm's unit is the interacting pair a resident holds), then time. Pattern none: G2 (grain, the pair within a regimen against the medicine) then G6 (the review moves the pair mix far from the record's). Strategy grain_or_unit: the decisive move is the unit of exposure; answered in the design note against three_rules.strategy_risk. Forecast faces forward: admissions in calendar 2027 for residents during 2027, including residents not yet admitted to the homes.
